title: Elastic Load Balancing: application, network and gateway

videos.script: The shop has two machines and one address. Something has to stand between them. {{front}} That something is a load balancer, and AWS sells three kinds. {{three}} The application load balancer reads every request. It sees the host, the path and the headers, and sends each request to the group of machines that should answer it. {{alb}} The network load balancer reads much less. It passes connections through, very fast, from one fixed address per zone, and the machines behind it see who is really calling. {{nlb}} The gateway load balancer is the odd one. It sends traffic through a row of firewalls and back again, wrapped so that nothing about it changes on the way. {{gwlb}} You will build all three in moto, with their listeners, their rules and their target groups. And you will see moto call a machine healthy that does not even exist. {{health}} Then the two numbers that decide the bill. What crossing a zone costs, which lesson 1 priced. And what a load balancer costs by the hour, and by the unit of work it does. {{price}} By the end you can choose the kind for a job, and say what it will cost to leave it running. {{end}}
